headlines.text: It was 2025 when The Acclaimed left that name behind for good, stepping out as Bowens & Caster after 65 matches under the old identity, on Collision.

Rewind to 2024, when Castagnoli, PAC & Yuta vs. Private Party & Komander clashed for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Collision, rated 5.57. It was the first title opportunity of Private Party & Komander's career. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
Rewind to 2023, when Dynamite stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.03.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2025, when Kyle Fletcher vs. Komander fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Collision, rated 7.84 ? a solid showing.
2025 brought us this moment: Castagnoli, Garcia & Moxley kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.17 ? a good, competitive contest.
